name: Jerry Cook
office: Regional Superintendent of Schools, Kane County

items.text: He served as a principal in East Aurora School District 131 and School District U-46. In 2023, a school district ethics panel ruled he violated its gift ban policy by taking an all-expense-paid trip from an HVAC contractor. He supports expanding professional development for educators and strengthening college and career readiness pathways.
